notes.title: Radium Lux is now available on Steam!
Ra² is now available for iOS and Android
notes.content:
Good news, everyone!
The mobile version of Ra² is finally done and available for Android and iOS.

You can grab it on [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.develobster.ra2]Google Play[/url], [url=https://www.amazon.com/Lukas-Jaeckel-Ra%C2%B2/dp/B071ZLVXGB/]Amazon Apps[/url] and[url=https://itunes.apple.com/tw/app/id1242345957] iTunes[/url].
